One reference page per user-invocable skill, under budget

GH-3902, milestone 167. Every user-invocable skill already had a generated page, but four of them scored over the 25K-token page ceiling ora.ai grades against: one flat .mdx each, the largest 225 KB. The split mechanism from the configure work now covers all four, and the drift test fails if any user-invocable page goes missing or over the line again.

The four pages that crossed the line

The line is 90,000 bytes, about 25K tokens at 4 characters per token. It is one constant shared three ways: SPLIT_OVER_BYTES in the generator decides where to split, and PAGE_BUDGET_BYTES in the drift test fails any user-invocable page that crosses it.

What changed, four pieces

PieceWhereWhat it does
split list widenedscripts/_build-docs-generate.py, SPLIT_SKILLSconfigure (from the earlier PR) joined by doctor, implement, verify and brainstorm: the four user-invocable skills whose assembled page measured over the line. Opt-in per skill, guarded by size, exactly as before.
third split levelchunk_file_sections()a single reference file that is itself over budget (doctor's 480-row CC version Feature Matrix, 114 KB) becomes ## Heading chunks under references/<file>/. A leading table header row repeats on every part after the first, so each chunk still renders as a table.
wrapper reservePART_PAGE_RESERVEthe part-page frontmatter, part-of note and heading add bytes on top of the measured content. Every split decision budgets against the line minus this reserve, so a part page cannot tip over it after the wrapper lands.
drift coveragetests/skills/structure/test-docs-site-drift.mjshard failures, not a ratchet: every user-invocable skill must have a reference page (flat file or split index), and every page file of a user-invocable skill must sit under the budget. The new part pages are also swept by the existing dead-command and stale-total scans.

The result

33 generated .mdx files across the four skills, every one under the line; the largest is the Feature Matrix's first part at 89 KB. The flat URLs (/docs/reference/skills/doctor and friends) still resolve, because each split index keeps them. The search index picked up the new part pages, bringing it to 311 entries.

Bars are real byte sizes measured at this branch's head: the four flat pages as this branch found them, and the largest file of each split output. Verified with test:skills (drift gate included), the docs-site vitest suite (55 files, 607 tests) and a clean next build before the PR opened.
